lines.py: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng mǎi shuǐguǒ.
lines.en: Hello, I'd like to buy some fruit.

lines.hz: 我们有苹果、芒果和西瓜。
lines.py: Wǒmen yǒu píngguǒ, mángguǒ hé xīguā.
lines.en: We have apples, mangoes and watermelon.

lines.hz: 好，我要一个西瓜和两个苹果。
lines.py: Hǎo, wǒ yào yí ge xīguā hé liǎng ge píngguǒ.
lines.en: OK, I'll take one watermelon and two apples.

lines.hz: 我有雨伞，我们一起走吧。

grammar.en: Pictographs began as simple drawings of the thing itself; over time the lines became strokes

drills.en: The character that looks like the sun is 日.

drills.q: 看上去像弯弯的月亮的字是“___”。
drills.en: The character that looks like a crescent moon is 月.

drills.q: 像一个侧面站着的人的字是“___”。
drills.en: The character that looks like a person standing in profile is 人.
The character that looks like a fish is 鱼.
Water falling from the sky is written 雨.

grammar.en: Words made from the lesson's characters

drills.en: He takes the train to Beijing.
It's raining; I need to take an umbrella.
Apples and mangoes are both fruit.

drills.q: 我的儿子和女儿都是我的___。
drills.en: My son and my daughter are both my children.
The son of the king and queen is the prince.
Dad drives to work every day.
It's my birthday today and I am very happy.

drills.q: 我最喜欢吃___，它是一种鱼。
drills.en: I like salmon best; it's a kind of fish.

lines: 我想喝热水，不想喝冰水。
我想买一个西瓜和三个苹果。

judge.text: 他有一个儿子和一个女儿，一共两个孩子。
国王住在大房子里，王子也住在大房子里。
我不喝牛奶，可是牛肉我每天都吃。
下雨了，所以他没有开车，坐公共汽车去。

replies.a: 我很开心，今天是我的生日。

chars: 日
A round sun with a dot in the middle; the circle became a box.
月
A crescent moon with a mark inside; it is narrower than 日.
人
A person seen from the side, leaning forward with legs apart.
子
A baby wrapped up in cloth, with a head and arms.
火
Flames leaping up, with a high tongue in the middle.
水
A stream with ripples on both sides of a centre line.
牛
An ox head seen from the front, with two horns pointing up.
雨
A cloud above with drops of rain falling under it.
女
A woman kneeling with her arms folded in front.
心
A heart with its curve at the bottom and dots above.
瓜
A melon hanging from a vine.
果
A round fruit (田) growing on a tree (木).
王
Once the blade of a big axe, a symbol of a ruler's power.
车
Seen from above, a cart with two wheels and an axle.
鱼
A fish with its head, scales and a tail.
木
A tree with branches on top and roots below.
目
An eye turned on its side; now it stands upright.
耳
An ear with its outer curve and a small hole.
羊
A sheep's head with two curved horns.
竹
Two bamboo stems with leaves drooping.
门
A gate with two doors; the full form 門 shows both leaves.
马
A horse with a mane and four legs, simplified from 馬.
structure: Characters that began as simple drawings of the object itself. The lines were straightened over the centuries until they became the strokes you write today.
